name: Scenes From A Bar Off North Halsted
source:
Macaulay Steiger has no luck with dates. Maybe it's him, or maybe it's  the bar in North Chicago he keeps bringing his dates to. Either way, while he sits at the bar, waiting for his next date to arrive, Mac revisits some of his unsuccessful dates. Who knows... maybe this one will be different.

[From [url=https://shiroooo-dev.itch.io/sfabonh]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
麦考利·施泰格在约会方面运气不佳。也许是他，或者也许是他经常带着约会对象去的北芝加哥酒吧。不管怎样，当麦克坐在酒吧里等待下一个约会对象到来时，他会重新审视一些不成功的约会。谁知道呢……也许这次会有所不同。
